caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with detailed painted decorations. The chest is primarily a reddish-brown color, with panels and borders in various shades of green, blue, and gold. The front panel features two large circular designs with star motifs inside, flanking a central arch that contains floral patterns and a star near the top. Columns with geometric and floral designs are present on either side of the central panel, and the upper part of the front is decorated with a horizontal band of geometric shapes and the numbers "17" and "99" indicating the year 1799. The chest sits on four feet, with a thick base, and has three rectangular drawers at the bottom, each with a gold-colored handle and bordered by green and gold geometric designs. The sides of the chest are decorated with tree-like motifs inside circular outlines, and additional geometric banding and circular patterns are present on the sides as well. The overall composition of the chest is symmetrical, and the artwork includes fine detailing in each section. The name "Carl Strehlau" is written in small letters on the left side beneath the chest.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
